svg.aria-label: Map of the corridors filed for study in PUCT Docket 59182, the Oncor and LCRA Big Hill to Sand Lake 765 kV transmission line project. 173 alternative routes, 197 to 222 miles, from Sand Lake Switch in Ward County to Big Hill Substation in Schleicher County. No route has been approved.
svg.title: Blu Lacy–Howard 765 kV preliminary route links — National ROW
svg.desc: Map of the 169 preliminary links AEP Texas and CPS Energy published for the proposed Blu Lacy–Howard 765 kV transmission line across eleven Texas counties.
svg.text: Blu Lacy–Howard 765 kV — Preliminary Route Links
AEP Texas & CPS Energy · No PUCT filing yet · No route filed · 169 preliminary links · ~150 miles · Nueces County to Bexar County
(link-miles = all links drawn in the county)
NO ROUTE HAS BEEN FILED OR APPROVED. These are the preliminary links published for comment — they will be narrowed to the routes filed at the PUCT, and one route will be chosen.
The agency has a team. Now you do too.
Owner-side only, nationwide, since the 1980s. We never work for the condemning agency, utility or pipeline.
No upfront cost — contingency only. Our fee is a percentage of the additional compensation we secure;
if we don’t increase your payout, you owe us nothing. Legal counsel coordinated when your case requires it.
National ROW is a right-of-way consulting firm, not a law firm. Nothing here is legal advice.
FREE REVIEW BY A SENIOR CONSULTANT
Text or email a photo of your offer letter — we read it free.
Link geometry redrawn from the preliminary links AEP Texas and CPS Energy publish on their public comment map, read 20 November 2026; county coverage computed by
intersecting the links with US Census county boundaries. Grey dashed lines are the companion Hillje–Blu Lacy line. No route has been filed; the built easement will be about 200 feet wide.
This map is an approximation for landowner orientation. It is not a survey, not an appraisal, and not legal advice.
